summary: User received a message through Facebook Messenger claiming they had been given access to a cryptocurrency wallet containing millions of USDT. The fraudulent website required a separate withdrawal key and was expected to demand fees before funds could be withdrawn.
user_mistake: Trusted an unsolicited message claiming to transfer ownership of a cryptocurrency wallet
prevention: Ignore unsolicited offers involving inherited or gifted cryptocurrency / Never pay fees to unlock or withdraw funds from a wallet you did not create
